name: Konami Viper Recomp: Thrill Drive 2 & GTI Club 2

game.label: Your folder of MAME files: the Viper BIOS kviper (941b01.u25, ds2430.u3) with thrild2 (a41b02.chd, a41ebb_nvram.u39) and/or gticlub2 (941b02.chd, 941jab_nvram.u39), loose or in MAME's zips, in any layout. Keep it where it is: the games read the CHDs from it.

prepare.label: Building the games from your files, about a minute each

settings.label: Mode
settings.help: Enhanced plays like a PC game, with menus, options and pause. Classic is the arcade cabinet: coins, attract mode and TEST MODE, at 30 fps.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: The games' NVRAM (rankings, options, calibration) and the port's settings.

exit_codes.66: This game isn't built: your folder didn't have all its files. Add them (see Required files in the README) and pick your folder again.
